correctness.rationale: Computed the 24 vertices and 36 edges for both open intervals from the active cube/octahedral half-spaces. A generic plane crosses an edge precisely when its endpoint normal dot-products have opposite signs, with edge-crossing probability angle(u,v)/pi. Ordering |n1|>|n2|>|n3| yields on t<2 N=6+2[b<sa]+2[c<sa]-2[c<sb] and on t>2 N=8+2I-2J-2L-2K, with the four indicators exactly as in RESULT.md. The region N=10 on each side is a spherical three-ray cone with 48 signed-order chambers; the region N=4 on the cubic side is a cone with 24 symmetric copies. Solid-angle probabilities plus normalization and independently derived expected edge crossings determine all other masses. At t=1,2,3 the limits give octahedron/cuboctahedron/cube laws, while analytic derivatives of M- and M+ are strictly positive/negative, proving uniqueness of the mean maximum. Independent exact-rational edge reconstruction and 200 random integer normals at six rational parameters reproduced the chamber formula; 14,000 independently Gaussian normals at each of six t values agreed with the derived pmfs (stochastic corroboration, not proof).
